summary: Excellent TypeScript implementation with clear separation of concerns, proper types, and thorough validation. Workflow structure is solid (pinned refs, least-privilege permissions). Critical gaps: (1) test harness uses fragile sed mutations (run-act-tests.sh lines ~75-76) without error checking—if YAML structure changes, mutations silently fail; (2) missing package.json with `typecheck`/`start` scripts—workflow calls these but they're undefined; (3) temp cleanup in bash lacks trap protection; (4) no error handling on sed operations. Sed patterns with pipes and quotes are error-prone. Policy pipeline could be more extensible. Core logic is maintainable and well-documented, but test infrastructure and configuration are incomplete/brittle.
